title: Kononenkogroup link
description: A plain text link with a 1px underline that draws in from the left on hover over 0.6s; the active link is underlined at rest and its underline slides off to the right on hover.
notes: the underline takes the text colour (currentColor), so it works on any background
name: kononenkogroup-link

props.name: active
props.description: the current page: underlined at rest, and the underline retracts to the right on hover

props.name: underlined
props.description: underlined at rest like the active link, without marking it as the current page
